ctx.x: So that's when you started working with Dizzy and Pettiford Pennifort.

Yeah, and some of the tunes I had to learn, they were pretty difficult, I'm going to tell you, because this is in the bop thing. So we had heard Diz, you know, and everybody was very interested in the new music and so this is -- all due respect to what Dizzy did later on, Pettiford I mean I used to put down the melodies for Oscar Patty. He would say, 'hey Buddy, write this down, I've got a tune,' and these are the kind of tunes we were doing. And this -- what they call 'one base hit' Oscar wrote that tune and it…
"Wax", and we were playing like "Salt Peanuts", and we were playing like (Singing of notes) salt peanuts, salt peanuts, and we were playing like (singing of notes).
